caption: The drawing depicts a tan-colored ceramic beer stein with a handle on the right side and blue decorative dots near the top of the handle. The stein has a blue band around its base. Inscribed on its side, in neat, dark blue script, are the words “Wm Stoeckert 1890 Ulm.” The main image of the stein is centered inside a large bordered rectangle. In the bottom left and bottom right corners of the page, outside the main rectangle, are two smaller outlined sketches of the same stein, each showing different angles: the left sketch is a side view showing the handle, and the right sketch is a front view displaying the inscription. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the artist’s name, “Wilbur M. Rice,” is written in small letters in the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Earthenware Beer Mug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
